change0: ### Summary: Unnamed Tasks are now named with the first action in the Task
change2: - Added: Add unnamed Tasks (e.g. Scene related tasks) to the directory.
change3: - Added: Hover over Profile now includes a list of Tasks in the Map view.
change4: - Added: All unnamed Tasks now have a name consisting of the first action in the Task.
change6: - Changed: 'Debug' mode no longer requires the XML file to be named 'backup'.
change7: - Changed: Unnamed Tasks now have the name of the first action. Example: 'If %fast ~ no.475 (Unnamed)', where '475' is the Task id.
change9: - Fixed: Hover over Task name in Map view gives program error if Task is not associated with a Profile.
change10: - Fixed: 'Cancel Entry' button mistakenly leaves a '?' in the GUI.
change11: - Fixed: Incorrectly including a '0' in the Profile name if it is anonymous.
change12: - Fixed: Hover over a Project that has anonymous Profiles does display the Tasks under those Profiles.
change13: - Fixed: Cleaned up unnamed Profile (conditional) names.
change14: - Fixed: Task action output with 'continued >' lines are incorrectly being included in the action count.
change15: - Fixed: Program error if searching for string in the Diagram view.
change17: - Unable to change any colors in GUI if using UV to manage the application (UV bug).
